entry.title: Costello Reverb 1.0.1
entry.summary: Costello Reverb 1.0.1: installer fix. The reverb itself is unchanged from 1.0.0 (same `costello_reverb.so`). - `install.sh` now finds the right folder by itself: on MPC OS 3.10.1 and later it installs into `<drive>/VST2 Plugins` (Gen1 internal drive: `/sdcard/VST2 Plugins`), where the plugin browser looks, and an existing copy there is updated in place. 1.0.0's installer used `/sdcard/Synths` unless given `-t`, which the 3.10.1 browser does not list. - Tested on an MPC Live (Gen1), MPC OS 3.10.1

entry.title: Costello Reverb 1.0.0
entry.summary: Costello Reverb 1.0.0: the Costello reverb (Soundpipe revsc, as wrapped by AudioKit's SoundpipeAudioKit) as an MPC OS insert effect. Five Q-Links: LOW CUT, HIGH CUT, VERB SIZE, MIX, OUTPUT. Seven presets. - `Costello-Reverb-1.0.0-mpc-armv7.zip`: Gen1 (Live, Live II, One, X, Key 61/37, Force). Tested on an MPC Live, MPC OS 3.10.1.
